spec.scope: Unlocked self-draw win windows only, including kong bloom. No changes to external wins or locked seats.
spec.opportunityProxy: Require existing route minWallForCommit / minWallForCommitWithJokers even when behind.
spec.intervention: When only the deficit exception lets a route remove win, disable route narrowing for this decision; original EV still chooses win/reform/kong.
spec.notClaimed: Wall length is an opportunity proxy, not a calibrated completion probability or a proof a route is impossible.

interval: 4000 source-seed bootstrap replicates; each seed averages its four seat-rotated East matches; includes no-change matches.
